carry.palm_z_m.note: palm height above the pelvis while carrying (the body hangs ~15 cm)

crouch.edge_change_per_0p1rad_m.note: g1_crouch forward_rad +0.1 brought the edge closer by this much

grasp.finger_links_ahead_of_palm_m.note: open Dex3 finger links ahead of the palm frame (wrist yaw 0): check against box walls

grasp.palm_stall_above_depth_top_m.note: pressed palm stops this far above the depth-measured plush top

grip.lift_step_m.note: lift step per 4 s that kept the grip (a 4 cm / 3 s step slipped)

grip.lost_threshold_rad.note: index/middle base joint above this during the carry = grip lost (empty fist ~1.53)

hand.dex3_opening_m.note: Dex3 opening between thumb and fingers

reach.loaded_palm_max_x_m.note: farthest measured palm ahead of the pelvis with the puppy in hand (waist yaw cmd 0.7, lean 0.1)

reach.right_lateral_limit_y_m.note: right hand cannot press into the plush beyond this y (pelvis frame)

release.lean_rad.note: gated lean at release for a box behind the puppy, unlean right after

release.palm_past_near_wall_m.note: measured palm past the box near wall before opening (+0.04 fell back out)

robot.hands_hanging_ahead_m.note: standing, hands hang this far ahead of the pelvis at table height (and read as the table edge)

robot.stance_from_edge_m.note: pelvis to table edge the controllers work from; closer and the hanging hands hit the edge

waist.yaw_tracking_ratio.note: measured / commanded waist yaw (cmd 0.7 -> 0.24-0.37), keeps creeping for seconds

walk.carry_advance_short_m.note: what a 0.07-0.15 m carry=true g1_walk near the table actually moved (often ~0); verify with a floor mark

walk.odometry_error_m.note: leg odometry vs truth on forward walks of 0.1-0.3 m (first walk after start can read 0 and still move)
